statement: Metric inventories consume only reports bound by one shared provenance owner to their measured source/configuration, producer and installed tool identity. Producers seal reports; inventory refreshes stale reports only and retains the matching-input fast path. No unsealed legacy fallback, report-mtime authority, duplicate metric policy, ratchet increase, protocol gate or release-acceptance claim.

constraints.statement: Metric report producer/consumer provenance and its behavioral witnesses, metadata and normal-hook preservation only. Original Q6 and integration trees are read-only.
Independent delta review and applicable exact-source gates remain separate from this author WIP.
